disclose: The build is flagged italic and named so where the release is not: fontc sets the OS/2 fsSelection ITALIC bit and name ID 2 "Italic" whenever the italic angle is non-zero (-13 here), while FontForge took italic from macStyle, which this source leaves upright; a .glyphs source cannot state otherwise. Decided 2026-10-01: disclose.
earlier_sources: https://github.com/googlefonts/googlefontdirectory-hg at 52f780bc9d197280a9f430574e179a5f233c56b6: src/NovaScript.sfd, a FontForge source whose points differ from the release's in 17 glyphs, so the release's TrueType hinting could not apply to a build from it; converted from the shipped font instead (Felipe, 2026-11-06, bottleneck 0h2 b; tools/probes/hinting/ROUTE-A.md).
